Write a précis of the following passage. Supply a suitable title.

Fill in the blanks with appropriate preposition
(a) He was accused ______ murder.
(b) I insisted _______ his going there.
(c) Our parents did not approve ______ our conduct.
(d) How does this differ ________ the other?
(e) We must abide _______ the rule.
(f) The woman has no control _______ her tongue.
(g) She is wanting _____ common sense.
(h) I sympathise _____ you in your sorrow.
(i) This forest abounds ________ wild animals.
(j) Greedy people always hanker _________ money (10×1=10)

Fill in the blanks with the correct tense of the verbs given in brackets
(a) Look! Smoke _____ (come) out of the window.
(b) At this time tomorrow I ______ (sit) in the bus.
(c) The nurse ______ (look) after the children.
(d) He has _________ a fancy to the pretty girl (take).
(e) That girl ______ a good singer (be).

Correct the following sentences without changing their meaning
(a) He is one of the villagers who is trustworthy.
(b) Every festival are different in my country.
(c) It is a month since they left the place.
(d) You must distribute the sweets between the whole class.
(e) Neither the husband nor the wife were at home.
(f) I have a strong headache.
(g) Your pen is superior than mine.
(h) He is more wiser than me.
(i) Shakespeare is greater than any dramatist.
(j) Radha is the eldest of the two sisters. (5) (10×1=10)

Rewrite the following sentences as directed
(a) Someone is knocking on the door. (to passive voice)
(b) Inspite of old age, he can run fast. (to compound)
(c) Go wherever your leader goes. (to simple)
(d) Is the baby loved by you? (to active voice)
(e) He said to me that he lived in Aizawl for five year. (to direct speech)
(f) The old man said, “Alas! I am undone.” (to indirect speech)
(g) He died in his native village. (to complex)
(h) He will do it. (to passive voice)
(i) The match can be won by our team. (to active voice)
(j) The queen said to the maid, “Bring my Crown.” (to indirect speech) (10×1=10)

(d) Fortune favours the brave. (2×5=10)
